markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Normal (99%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Models and neighbors agree on normal tissue [F1], with clear surgical margins [F7] despite severity-3 stain degradation.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | Normal 99%, InSitu 0%, Invasive 0% | Strong normal score; zero invasive risk |
| Conformal set | {Normal} (90% dataset coverage target) | Single class; no class ambiguity |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% reliability, 26th percentile OOD [F6] | Typical input; moderate error ranking |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Agree on top class | Independent foundation models concur |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Normal (88%–91% similarity) [F5] | Reference neighbors unanimously match Normal |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (regions 0, 1, 9) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical embedding score (-1.52 contribution), but 0/20 AI spot check [F2] · Unreliable
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 7, 9, 10) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical embedding score (-1.20 contribution; 20/20 AI spot check) [F3] · Validated
- **Gland / tubule formation** (region 6) · ↑ invasive · Below-typical text score (+0.36 contribution), caption-inconsistent (18/20 spot check) [F4] · Weak
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (region 3) · ↑ invasive · Below-typical score (+0.27 contribution; 12/20 AI spot check) · Weak

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; removing top 3 risk regions beats random removal (drop +0.0114, 95% CI 0.0021 to 0.0197).
- **Concepts**: Unproven classifier faithfulness (95% CI -0.0088 to 0.0064 includes 0); leans on Unreliable normal lobules (0/20 spot check).

## Could be wrong if
- Severity-3 stain degradation on this simulated frozen section masks in situ disease (contrast case BACH_0043 is 80% similar).
- Focal atypia exists at the inferior margin, where segment scores reach 93% and 85% despite clear call.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 8, 3, 2**: Inspect the only non-zero risk regions (up to 1% risk) for subtle ductal atypia.
2. **Regions 9, 10, 4**: Verify inferior (93%, 85%) and medial (62%) surgical margins are truly free of tumor.
3. **Regions 0, 1, 6**: Confirm genuine two-layered lobules (Unreliable concept) and evaluate scarce tubules under severity-3 stain degradation.
